metadata.name: GetStatementInformation
metadata.description: Use this API to retrieve the statement consisting of transactions posted on the card account during a statement period/cycle. This API retrieves the list of transactions and its details which can be Used to print a statement.

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked Example: 1.3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of sender Example:  10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source from where API Call is initiated. CoreCard have multiple value of source for internal system (CoreMoney, SelfService, IVR, MobileSelfService) For external system expected source will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller Id of source from where API is initiated. It is End User phone number. Example: 7204454214 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called Id of destination for which API is initiated. It is Corecard IVR number. Example: 7314145404 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ANI
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: DNS
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Flag to retrieve error message in specific language Example: 'en' for English Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RequestDate
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM-DD-YYYYTHH:MM:SS Example:- 11-12-2021T13:05:10 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Clear Card Number of the cardholder Valid values: 0-9 Example: 123456******0001 Condition:At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number is required. Allowable Values: 16

request_fields.name: ProxyNumber
request_fields.description: Proxy Number of the cardholder Valid values:0-9 Example:1005 Condition:At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number is required. Allowable Values: 19

response_fields.name: Message
response_fields.description: Returns Error Message in case of Error.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: Returns result of API processing. If any error is found then value will be 'false' else 'true'.

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Returns Error Code in case of Error.

response_fields.name: ResponseData
response_fields.description: This is group of below data elements.

children.name: AccountNumber
children.description: Account Number of the cardholder. Valid values: 0-9 Example: 2000000000000396893

children.name: CustomerId
children.description: Unique ID linked to the customer Valid Values:0-9 Example: 3212212

children.name: CustomerName
children.description: Name of the customer

children.name: CardLimit
children.description: Total Available Balance Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 120.00

children.name: CardNumber
children.description: Clear Card Number of the cardholder Valid values: 0-9 Example: 123456******0001

children.name: AddressLine1
children.description: Address Line 1 of the Cardholder Valid values : A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: 15 Penang Street Point

children.name: ReprintIndicator
children.description: Reserved for future use

children.name: AddressLine2
children.description: Address Line 2 of the Cardholder Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: 1 mecca way

children.name: City
children.description: Cardholder's City of residence Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: Norcross

children.name: State
children.description: Cardholder State of residence Valid values are A-Z, a-z Example: GA Please refer Appendix Section : State Codes (US)

children.name: Country
children.description: Two Character Country Code Valid values :A-Z, a-z Example: US Refer Appendix section : Country Code Values

children.name: PostalCode
children.description: Cardholder Postal Code of Residence Valid Values:A-Z,a-z,0-9 Example: 30093

children.name: PurchasesAndDebits
children.description: Sum of Debits  and Credit Reversals

children.name: TotalFees
children.description: Sum of all fees

children.name: TotalPaymentsCreditsReturns
children.description: Sum of Credits and Debit Reversals

children.name: CurrentBalance
children.description: This tag indicates the current balance of the account

children.name: StatementPeriod
children.description: Reserved for future use

children.name: StatementDate
children.description: Statement Date. Format: MMDDYYYY Example:01202021

children.name: LastStatementDate
children.description: Last Statement Date Format: MMDDYYYY Example: 09032021

children.name: DisputeAmount
children.description: Disputed amount on the card Example : 100

children.name: MessageNumber
children.description: Message number

children.name: MessageType
children.description: Type of message

children.name: StatementMessage
children.description: Message defined for Statement

children.name: EndingBalance
children.description: Current Balance at the end of month Example:200.00

children.name: MerchantLocationName
children.description: Name of the merchant and its location from where the transaction initiated

children.name: CustomAccountID
children.description: Any custom ID which is used to uniquely identify the Account. Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example:123456789

children.name: NextStatementDate
children.description: Next Statement Date Format: MM/DD/YYYY Example: 09/03/2021

children.name: StatementLogo
children.description: Path where the logo of the product is placed.

children.name: AnnualErrorResolutionText
children.description: Annual Error Resolution Text from the product

children.name: DisplayAnnualErrorResolutionNotice
children.description: Annual Error Resolution Notice

children.name: FeeName
children.description: Name of the Fee

children.name: TotalFeeForPeriod
children.description: Sum of all fees in given month

children.name: TotalFeeForYear
children.description: Sum of all fees in given Year

children.name: HeaderEmail
children.description: Email to be displayed in header

children.name: HeaderCall
children.description: Call center number to be displayed in header

children.name: HeaderWebsite
children.description: Website to be displayed in header

children.name: FooterName
children.description: Name to be displayed in footer

children.name: FooterAddLineOne
children.description: Address line one to be displayed in footer

children.name: FooterAddLineTwo
children.description: Address line two to be displayed in footer

children.name: FooterCity
children.description: City to be displayed in footer

children.name: FooterState
children.description: State to be displayed in footer

children.name: FooterPostalCode
children.description: Postal code to be displayed in footer

children.name: SavingAccountTransaction
children.description: Purpose is to display the Saving txns list Application Version is 1.3

children.name: SequenceNumber
children.description: Card Sequence Number Valid Values:0-9 Example: 3

children.name: StatementDate
children.description: Statement Date. Format: yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss Example:2017-09-26T00:00:00

children.name: TransactionDate
children.description: Date of transaction posted on account Format: yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss Example:2017-09-26 00:00:00

children.name: TransactingCardNumber
children.description: Card number from which card transaction has been performed in masked form.

children.name: TransactionID
children.description: Unique number assigned to a transaction and is used to track the transaction posted in CoreCard System Example :  147852369

children.name: TransactionDescription
children.description: Description of transaction Valid Values:A-Z,a-z Example: Load

children.name: TransactionCode
children.description: This tag indicates the transction code that is displayed after a transaction is executed. Example: ABC14433222

children.name: TransactionAmount
children.description: Transaction Amount to be posted Valid value 0-9 Example: 300, 3.5

children.name: TransactionDebitCreditIndicator
children.description: Indicator showing transaction type Valid Values: CR for credit, DR for debit Example : CR

children.name: MerchantNameAndLocation
children.description: Name of the merchant and its location from where the transaction initiated

children.name: TransactionType
children.description: Transaction Code which indicates type of transaction

children.name: TypeOfTransaction
children.description: Unique number assigned to a transaction and is used to track the transaction posted in CoreCard System Example :  147852369

children.name: MerchantType
children.description: Merchant Type. Example : 3021=Air Algerie Please refer Appendix  Merchant Type.

children.name: MerchantTypeDescription
children.description: Merchant Type Description Example : Air Conditioning, Heating, and Plumbing Contractors

children.name: SpendCategory
children.description: Category of Transaction

children.name: BalanceAtTransaction
children.description: Balance available after a particular transaction Valid Values:0-9 Example : 100.00

children.name: ProxyNumber
children.description: Proxy Number of the cardholder Valid values:0-9 Example:1005

children.name: StatementPDFData
children.description: Statement pdf in bytes. Content type/MIME will be 'application/pdf'
